title: pkg/api/handlers/libpod: quadlets multipart differs from manifests
body:
`processMultipartQuadlets` and the manifests upload handler both read a client multipart stream and write each part into a directory, but they handle it differently.

`manifests.go` wraps each part in a closure so `part.Close()` and the file close run per iteration, with a comment saying that is deliberate. `quadlets.go` defers both inside the loop, so a request with many parts holds every handle open until the function returns.

`manifests.go` also opens with `O_CREATE|O_EXCL|O_WRONLY`, so a repeated filename is an error. `quadlets.go` uses `os.Create`, so a second part named the same as an earlier one silently overwrites it.

Should quadlets follow manifests here, and should a duplicate filename be an error or documented as last-wins?
